Two killed in Manipur village attack, fresh tension reported

Two individuals were killed and two others injured in an attack on Langka Naga village in Manipur's Kuki-majority Kangpokpi district. The incident has reportedly led to fresh tension and emergency shutdowns in Naga areas. The attack is described by some outlets as an alleged act by Kuki extremists, while others refer to it as fresh violence.
